easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{R}
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Palinchron from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
